get.description: Required App profile and owner-bound onboarding context. Selected installation verification/readiness is integrated in the following slices; this operation remains IN_PROGRESS until acceptance.
x-invariants: workspaceId is nonzero UUID; authorizationContextId is nonzero UUID when provided.
installationId requires authorizationContextId; installationPage requires installationId.
Context AUTHORIZED is required for INSTALLATION_SELECTION_REQUIRED and all verified branches.
Verified installationId equals requested installationId; metadata App identity equals pinned configured App.
repositoryAccessVerified is always false; this is not a repository connection capability.
No write, token mint/refresh, or hidden installation pagination scan in API-046 GET.

post.description: Proposed new operation. Verified LivingDocs JWT + current Workspace policy + exact Origin. Server creates one-time state, S256 PKCE, scoped HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax nonce cookie. Does not create a connection or issue a LivingDocs session. Repeated requests may create separate bounded contexts; no idempotency guarantee.

get.summary: Consume integration OAuth callback; never logs code/state/query
get.description: Protocol-specific exception, not anonymous API-046 access or S01 login. Requires authenticated opaque state, matching nonce cookie, unexpired DB context and one-time CAS claim before code exchange. code xor error; exact redirect URI, S256 PKCE. Stores only encrypted short-lived GitHub user token after immutable user identity verification. Fixed frontend redirect carries contextId only. Completion requires a second conditional commit from EXCHANGING while unexpired/not cancelled and owner/App/config/row revision still match. If cancel/expiry won, discard returned credential and never revive the context. Optional provider error_description/error_uri are ignored/redacted.
